sentences.en: The unprecedented drought did severe damage to the wheat harvest.
sentences.zh: 这场史无前例的旱灾对小麦收成造成了严重破坏。

sentences.en: The Japanese economy was in an unprecedented boom at that time.
sentences.zh: 当时日本经济正处于前所未有的繁荣期。

sentences.en: This winter began with an unprecedented amount of snow.
sentences.zh: 这个冬天开始时降雪量达到了空前的程度。

senses.zh: 前所未有的，无前例的,空前的,无比的,新奇的，崭新的
